title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic ships Claude Ship (Nov 23): three GitHub pull-request agents, with Code Review GA and PR Steward + Approvals in public beta, plus a /ship command in Claude Code
bullets.summary: The agents review, fix and shepherd pull requests on GitHub; Anthropic says most reviews finish in 6-10 minutes.
bullets.how: The Construct: put Code Review and PR Steward on the hartley-command and B9 site repos so the sentinel agents' fixes land as reviewed PRs, not direct pushes, which is the fix-as-PR loop we flagged last week. PRAGMA: a ready reference for 'agents propose, humans approve' in client engineering teams.

bullets.title: Canva MCP is generally available, with new REST APIs and a command-line tool so AI agents can create and edit Canva designs
bullets.summary: Canva moves its MCP server out of preview and adds developer APIs and a CLI aimed at agents and coding tools.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: Canva is already connected in Cowork, so a design agent can draft sign mockups, social posts and client proofs straight into Canva brand templates. The Construct: a GA, supported design MCP is safer to build standing jobs on than preview tools.

bullets.title: Google ships semantic governance policies in Preview (Nov 23): a judge LLM checks every tool call an agent proposes and blocks it before it runs if it breaks a plain-language company rule or doesn't match the user's request
bullets.summary: The check sits outside the agent at an enforcement point such as Agent Gateway; the user-intent check is on by default, verdicts and rationale go to Cloud Logging, and Google recommends dry-run first because LLM verdicts can vary.
bullets.how: The Construct: the same pattern fits our MCP fleet, a pre-execution gate that reads each send/order/publish call against written rules and logs the verdict, sitting outside Hermes and Cowork rather than in their prompts. PRAGMA: a big-vendor reference design for the 'policy outside the agent' layer we sell.

bullets.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise (Nov 23)
bullets.summary: OpenAI says the update follows complex instructions better and reads small visual details more reliably.
bullets.how: The Construct: re-run our proof-reading and print-file checks (small text on sign artwork) against Sol next to Claude before choosing a model for that gate. Brand 9 Signs: better fine-detail reading matters for catching typos on proofs.

bullets.title: Agent observability consolidates: Elastic to acquire agent tracing/eval startup HoneyHive, Workday closes C1.ai for employee-and-agent identity governance, and open-source Show-Context visualizes which files Claude Code touches (Nov 23)
bullets.summary: Tracing, evaluation and per-agent identity are being folded into mainstream platforms, while a free tool shows exactly what a coding agent read during a session.
bullets.how: The Construct: try Show-Context on a Claude Code run against our repos and log each standing agent's runs as replayable traces. PRAGMA: tracing plus identity per agent is now a line item enterprise buyers expect.

praxis_lesson: Anthropic and Google both shipped the same shape this week: the agent proposes, and a separate reviewer (a PR agent or a judge model) checks the change before it lands. The Construct should route every sentinel fix and every send/publish through one reviewed path, so speed comes from the agents and safety comes from the gate.
